name: PdxDivider
description: A separator, horizontal or vertical, with an optional label.

members.name: label
members.description: The label. Unset, the element's text content is the label: `<pdx-divider>OR</pdx-divider>`.

members.name: labelPosition
members.description: Where the label sits relative to the control.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The label. Unset, the element's text content is the label: `<pdx-divider>OR</pdx-divider>`.

attributes.name: labelposition
attributes.description: Where the label sits relative to the control.

slots.description: The content placed inside the element.

cssParts.name: line
cssParts.description: A line: the `<hr>`, the vertical rule, or each line beside the label.

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: The label between the two lines.

cssStates.name: vertical
cssStates.description: `orientation="vertical"`: an inline rule between items on a line.

cssStates.name: label-left
cssStates.description: `labelPosition="left"`: the line before the label is short.

cssStates.name: label-right
cssStates.description: `labelPosition="right"`: the line after the label is short.
